Author: Jose
Description: Displays the battery level of the Razer Viper Ultimate and HyperX Cloud III S Wireless through direct HID communication, without Synapse or NGENUITY.
Name: Peripheral Battery

Actions.Name: Viper Ultimate Battery
Actions.Tooltip: Displays the Razer Viper Ultimate battery percentage. Press the key to refresh the reading.

Actions.Name: HyperX Cloud III S Battery
Actions.Tooltip: Displays the HyperX Cloud III S Wireless battery percentage. Press the key to refresh the reading.
